definitions.explanation: A dish of various vegetables quickly cooked in a hot pan or wok with oil. A staple of everyday Japanese home cooking and a common menu item at restaurants.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{晩|ばん}ご{飯|はん}→晩ご飯：02940_bangohan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{野菜炒|やさいいた}め⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Let's have stir-fried vegetables for dinner tonight.

examples.japanese: ⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{野菜炒|やさいいた}め⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{定食|ていしょく}→定食：03123_teishoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}んだ→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧。
examples.english: I ordered the meat and vegetable stir-fry set meal.

examples.japanese: {野菜炒|やさいいた}め⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{強火|つよび}→強火：08170_tsuyobi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一気|いっき}→一気：08891_ikki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{炒|いた}める→炒める：01879_itameru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦コツ→コツ：06658_kotsu⟧だ。
examples.english: The trick to stir-fried vegetables is to cook them all at once over high heat.

notes:
One of the most basic and common dishes in Japanese home cooking. Quick, cheap, and nutritious.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {野菜炒|やさいいた}め⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧ (to make stir-fried vegetables)
- {野菜炒|やさいいた}め⟦{定食|ていしょく}→定食：03123_teishoku⟧ (stir-fried vegetable set meal)
- ⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧{野菜炒|やさいいた}め (meat and vegetable stir-fry)

USAGE:
The ～⟦{炒|いた}め→炒める：01879_itameru⟧ pattern is productive: {豚肉炒|ぶたにくいた}め (stir-fried pork), ⟦もやし→もやし：10645_moyashi⟧{炒|いた}め (stir-fried bean sprouts), etc. {野菜炒|やさいいた}め is the most representative example of this pattern.
